source: FactSet AI-Ready Data connector (MCP): GlobalPrices prices, frequency D, adjust SPLIT (default), currency LOCAL (the listing currency of each series); pulled nightly by the cloud routine "FNAM Financials: FactSet peers and prices refresh"
notes: points = [date, close] in the listing currency, completed sessions only (a session still open comes back null and is skipped); split-adjusted, dividends not reinvested, like the Yahoo series it replaces.

The market fetchers and `apply` overlay these closes on data/market.js: FactSet wins on every date it carries; Yahoo/Stooq only fill dates FactSet has not posted yet and the history before this file starts.
The S&P/BMV IPC (^MXX) is not here: the connector rejects index ids, so the index stays on Yahoo Finance.
